title: Castles
description: Build towers and bridges. Then put them to the test against cannon fire.
versionOrder: Inferred development sequence, not established dates. The three tape23b drafts precede the two tape18a machine-code variants based on source changes. Within each capture, use save order.

versions.label: Artillery draft 1
versions.note: Initial build mode and compact impact routine.

versions.label: Artillery draft 3
versions.note: Persistent draw/erase modes, Q to bombard, refined falling routine.

versions.label: FALL BASIC 1
versions.note: Same builder, but impacts call an external machine-code routine.
versions.unavailableReason: Requires an external FALL machine-code routine. This release preserves the BASIC but does not reconstruct or load that dependency.

versions.label: FALL BASIC 2
versions.note: Latest recovered BASIC with FALL assembly v6. Machine code is a documented modern assembly of unchanged recovered source.
